description: This file contains utility functions and definitions for handling UTF-8 and Unicode characters, including encoding detection, width calculations, BOM handling, and string manipulation tailored to UTF-8 strings. It appears to be part of a larger project related to text processing within a version control system (e.g., Git).

methods.name: size_t display_mode_esc_sequence_len(const char * s)
methods.description: Calculates the length of terminal escape sequences for display purposes.

methods.name: int bisearch(ucs_char_t ucs,const struct interval * table,int max)
methods.description: Performs a binary search within a table of Unicode intervals.

methods.name: int git_wcwidth(ucs_char_t ch)
methods.description: Determines the display width of a Unicode character, considering combining and double-width characters.

methods.name: ucs_char_t pick_one_utf8_char(const char ** start,size_t * remainder_p)
methods.description: For extracting a single UTF-8 character from a string, updating the pointer accordingly.

methods.name: int utf8_width(const char ** start,size_t * remainder_p)
methods.description: Calculates the width of a UTF-8 character and advances the pointer.

methods.name: int utf8_strnwidth(const char * string,size_t len,int skip_ansi)
methods.description: Calculates the width of a UTF-8 string with possible ANSI sequences, with handling for invalid UTF-8.

methods.name: int utf8_strwidth(const char * string)
methods.description: Returns the display width of a null-terminated UTF-8 string.

methods.name: int is_utf8(const char * text)
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: void strbuf_add_indented_text(struct strbuf * buf,const char * text,int indent,int indent2)
methods.description: Adds indented, multi-line text to a strbuf.

methods.name: void strbuf_add_wrapped_text(struct strbuf * buf,const char * text,int indent1,int indent2,int width)
methods.description: Wraps text within a specified width, maintaining indentation.

methods.name: void strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes(struct strbuf * buf,const char * data,int len,int indent,int indent2,int width)
methods.description: Wraps byte data into a strbuf with indentation.

methods.name: void strbuf_utf8_replace(struct strbuf * sb_src,int pos,int width,const char * subst)
methods.description: Replaces part of a string buffer with a substitution text based on UTF-8 display width.

methods.name: int same_utf_encoding(const char * src,const char * dst)
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names represent the same UTF encoding.

methods.name: int is_encoding_utf8(const char * name)
methods.description: Determines if an encoding name refers to UTF-8.

methods.name: int same_encoding(const char * src,const char * dst)
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names refer to the same encoding accounting for case and variations.

methods.name: int utf8_fprintf(FILE * stream,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Prints formatted UTF-8 aware output to a file stream.

methods.name: char * reencode_string_iconv(const char * in,size_t insz,iconv_t conv,size_t bom_len,size_t * outsz_p)
methods.description: Converts a string from one encoding to another using iconv.

methods.name: const char * fallback_encoding(const char * name)
methods.description: Provides fallback encoding names for common cases.

methods.name: char * reencode_string_len(const char * in,size_t insz,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding,size_t * outsz)
methods.description: Converts a string from one encoding to another, handling BOMs when necessary.

methods.name: int has_bom_prefix(const char * data,size_t len,const char * bom,size_t bom_len)
methods.description: Checks if data starts with a specific Byte Order Mark.

methods.name: int has_prohibited_utf_bom(const char * enc,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks for forbidden BOMs in UTF-16/UTF-32 encodings.

methods.name: int is_missing_required_utf_bom(const char * enc,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks if a required BOM is missing for UTF-16/UTF-32 encodings.

methods.name: int mbs_chrlen(const char ** text,size_t * remainder_p,const char * encoding)
methods.description: Gets the length in bytes of the first character in a multi-byte string, supporting UTF-8.

methods.name: ucs_char_t next_hfs_char(const char ** in)
methods.description: Skips certain Unicode code points and returns the next relevant character for HFS+ filename comparisons.

methods.name: int is_hfs_dot_generic(const char * path,const char * needle,size_t needle_len)
methods.description: Checks if a path matches a specific dot-thing in a case-insensitive manner, considering HFS+ case folding.
